test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: iterutils.partition with multiple predicates."""


def test_partition_single_predicate():
    """partition with a single predicate should still work as before.
    
    Observable: partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1) == ([2, 3], [1])
    """
    from boltons.iterutils import partition
    result = partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1)
    assert result == ([2, 3], [1])


def test_partition_multiple_predicates():
    """partition with multiple predicates should return a tuple of lists,
    one per predicate, with remaining elements in the last bucket.
    
    Observable: partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3]) == ([2], [1], [3])
    """
    from boltons.iterutils import partition
    result = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3])
    assert result == ([2], [1], [3])


def test_partition_multiple_predicates_overlapping():
    """When predicates overlap, an element goes into the first matching bucket only."""
    from boltons.iterutils import partition
    # 5 matches both x > 2 and x > 3, but should go to first bucket
    result = partition([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [lambda x: x > 2, lambda x: x > 3])
    assert result[0] == [3, 4, 5]
    assert result[1] == [4, 5]


def test_partition_multiple_predicates_no_match_last_bucket():
    """When no elements satisfy any predicate, all go to the last bucket."""
    from boltons.iterutils import partition
    result = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 10, lambda x: x > 20])
    assert result == ([], [], [1, 2, 3])


def test_partition_multiple_predicates_empty_source():
    """partition with empty source and multiple predicates returns empty buckets."""
    from boltons.iterutils import partition
    result = partition([], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3])
    assert result == ([], [])
'''
